text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, indigotindisulfonate sodium has been on FDA's shortage list for 50 months. Corvale East holds 31 units (7.1 days on hand at 4.4 per day). Corvale General holds 64.7 units (15 days on hand at 4.3 per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 10 units (8.5 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2022-08-23. The product label for NDC 81284031505 identifies CENEXI (FEI 3007250542) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 924508 of that plant ended 2015-04-28 and was classified OAI with nine observations including SOPs not followed and batches formulated to less than 100%. The most recent inspection (1245208) ended 2022-10-26, classified VAI, 64 days after the shortage posting. FDA's records do not state that the inspection caused the shortage.

Our position: Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General can spare units while maintaining two weeks. Corvale Lakeside is near target. Sagent Pharmaceuticals is not on FDA's shortage list today, but its label names no plant we could place, so supply reliability is unknown.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 4 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Evaluate Sagent Pharmaceuticals as an alternate source — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No other transfers or purchases at this time.
